name: Attack runs
caveat: Counts runs, not distinct techniques; a run can contain several hops.

name: Attack runs by attack id
numerator: distinct ATTACK run ids per agentsec.attack.id
caveat: The attack id names the lab specimen (for example MCP-003), not a MITRE technique.

name: Confirmed unauthorized executions
numerator: hop-level guarded operations with status Verified ineffective (by-design subset shown); run-level retest failures are counted and shown separately
denominator: hop-level operations with an ALLOW, DENY or ERROR decision, shown beside the count
caveat: Includes the intentionally vulnerable profile; the by-design subset is shown separately.

name: Blocked operations (verified)
numerator: guarded operations with status Verified effective
denominator: DENY decisions in the same range, shown beside the count
caveat: A DENY without complete telemetry is Insufficient evidence and is excluded from the numerator.

name: Retest outcomes
numerator: ATTACK findings whose linked retest is VALIDATED
denominator: ATTACK findings with status Verified ineffective, with NO_RETEST and NOT_VALIDATED counted separately
caveat: Pairing is by attack id and control id only.

name: Runs with complete telemetry
numerator: runs whose sequence is contiguous from 1 and which have a run.completed event
caveat: A run that is still being ingested is incomplete until its last event arrives.

name: Controls without a qualifying test
numerator: controls in the control catalogue with no ATTACK or RETEST hop in the range
caveat: The catalogue lists the lab's own controls, not an organization's. The workshop filter does not apply to this metric (it would inflate the count); the time range and evidence class do.

name: Run start to first control decision (seconds)
numerator: median and maximum of (time of the first control decision minus time of run.started) within the same run
caveat: This is control-decision latency inside one run, NOT detection time: no alerting detection is enabled by default (DET-MCP-001 is packaged disabled), so a time to detection is Unavailable. Timestamps have one-second resolution, so most values are 0.
